newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 2.05 bln Ffr of 2007 OATs.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 2.05 bln Ffr of 2007 OATs.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold 2.045 billion francs of 2007 fixed-rate OATs after Thursday's auction, increasing the total value of bonds sold to 26.27 billion francs. It did not sell any more 2009 TEC 10.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 23 to 25 billion francs of OATs in total. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 2.6.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
